desc: Attappadi is the one and only tribal taluk in Kerala state covering an area of 735 km². It was carved out of Mannarkkad taluk in Palakkad district in February 2021. Attappadi Reserve Forest is a protected area comprising 249 km² of land in the western parts of Attappadi.

desc: The Dzukou Valley is a high-altitude valley in Northeast India, straddling the inter-state border of the states of Nagaland and Manipur. desc: Gulawat Lotus valley is a valley near Gulawat village at Hatod tehsil, Indore district, Madhya Pradesh, India.
